title: Rehearse real PostgreSQL migrations, private S3, and restore
acceptance_criteria: Confirm approved disposable infrastructure with unique Compose project, exclusively created resources and exact allowlisted targets before writes. If unavailable, record the block and seek approval; never use existing/live DSNs, destructive resets or shared deletes.

On Node24 generate/typecheck/build; fresh PostgreSQL migrate deploy/status/redeploy with no pending changes, and independently upgrade a prior-phase DB with two synthetic tenants/orders and preserved counts, constraints and snapshots.
Prove private bucket upload/read/cleanup and direct-read denial, then restore records and objects into a different isolated DB and bucket and compare results.
deliverables: Scrubbed commands and results for fresh/upgrade migrations, storage privacy/cleanup, and isolated backup/restore
